items.statement: Ensure consultants who advise on making, processing, packing or holding drug products have enough education, training and experience, or a combination of these, for the subject they are engaged to advise on.
items.quote: Consultants advising on the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of drug products shall have sufficient education, training, and experience, or any combination thereof, to advise on the subject for which they are retained.
items.condition: when consultants are retained

items.statement: Keep records of every consultant giving their name, address, qualifications and the kind of service they provide.
items.quote: Records shall be maintained stating the name, address, and qualifications of any consultants and the type of service they provide.
items.condition: when consultants are retained

items.statement: Ensure every building used to make, process, pack or hold drug products is of suitable size, construction and location to make cleaning, maintenance and proper operations easy.
items.quote: Any building or buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall be of suitable size, construction and location to facilitate cleaning, maintenance, and proper operations.

items.statement: Provide enough space in each building for equipment and materials to be placed in an orderly way, so that components, containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials and drug products are not mixed up and contamination is prevented.
items.quote: Any such building shall have adequate space for the orderly placement of equipment and materials to prevent mixups between different components, drug product containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials, or drug products, and to prevent contamination.

items.statement: Design the flow of components, containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials and drug products through the building(s) so that contamination is prevented.
items.quote: The flow of components, drug product containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials, and drug products through the building or buildings shall be designed to prevent contamination.

items.statement: Carry out operations in specifically defined areas that are of adequate size.
items.quote: Operations shall be performed within specifically defined areas of adequate size.

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for receiving, identifying, storing and holding back from use components, drug product containers, closures and labeling until the quality control unit has sampled, tested or examined them as appropriate and released them for manufacturing or packaging.
items.quote: Receipt, identification, storage, and withholding from use of components, drug product containers, closures, and labeling, pending the appropriate sampling, testing, or examination by the quality control unit before release for manufacturing or packaging;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups; pending QC release

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for holding rejected components, drug product containers, closures and labeling until their disposition.
items.quote: Holding rejected components, drug product containers, closures, and labeling before disposition;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups; before disposition

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for storing released components, drug product containers, closures and labeling.
items.quote: Storage of released components, drug product containers, closures, and labeling;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for storing in-process materials.
items.quote: Storage of in-process materials;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for manufacturing and processing operations.
items.quote: Manufacturing and processing operations;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for packaging and labeling operations.
items.quote: Packaging and labeling operations;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for quarantine storage of drug products before they are released.
items.quote: Quarantine storage before release of drug products;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups; before release

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for storing drug products after they are released.
items.quote: Storage of drug products after release;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups; after release

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for control and laboratory operations.
items.quote: Control and laboratory operations;
items.condition: as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

items.statement: Provide separate or defined areas, or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, for aseptic processing, including as appropriate the design and control features listed for aseptic areas (cleanable surfaces, temperature and humidity control, HEPA-filtered positive-pressure air, environmental monitoring, cleaning and disinfection, and maintenance of equipment that controls aseptic conditions).
items.quote: Aseptic processing, which includes as appropriate:
items.condition: aseptic processing; as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups

items.statement: For aseptic processing, within separate or defined areas or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, provide as appropriate floors, walls and ceilings with smooth, hard surfaces that are easy to clean.
items.quote: Floors, walls, and ceilings of smooth, hard surfaces that are easily cleanable;
items.condition: aseptic processing; as appropriate

items.statement: For aseptic processing, within separate or defined areas or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, provide as appropriate controls for temperature and humidity.
items.quote: Temperature and humidity controls;
items.condition: aseptic processing; as appropriate

items.statement: For aseptic processing, within separate or defined areas or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, provide as appropriate an air supply that is filtered through HEPA filters and kept under positive pressure, whether the airflow is laminar or not.
items.quote: An air supply filtered through high-efficiency particulate air filters under positive pressure, regardless of whether flow is laminar or nonlaminar;
items.condition: aseptic processing; as appropriate

items.statement: For aseptic processing, within separate or defined areas or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, provide as appropriate a system to monitor environmental conditions.
items.quote: A system for monitoring environmental conditions;
items.condition: aseptic processing; as appropriate

items.statement: For aseptic processing, within separate or defined areas or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, provide as appropriate a system to clean and disinfect the room and equipment so that aseptic conditions are achieved.
items.quote: A system for cleaning and disinfecting the room and equipment to produce aseptic conditions;
items.condition: aseptic processing; as appropriate

items.statement: For aseptic processing, within separate or defined areas or other control systems as necessary to prevent contamination or mixups, provide as appropriate a system to maintain any equipment that is used to control aseptic conditions.
items.quote: A system for maintaining any equipment used to control the aseptic conditions.
items.condition: aseptic processing; as appropriate

items.statement: Carry out manufacturing, processing and packing of penicillin in facilities kept separate from those used for other human drug products.
items.quote: Operations relating to the manufacture, processing, and packing of penicillin shall be performed in facilities separate from those used for other drug products for human use.
items.condition: penicillin operations

not_applicable.text: There shall be separate or defined areas or such other control systems
not_applicable.reason: lead-in; duty carried by each listed sub-paragraph

items.statement: Provide adequate lighting in every area.
items.quote: Adequate lighting shall be provided in all areas.

items.statement: Provide adequate ventilation.
items.quote: Adequate ventilation shall be provided.

items.statement: Where appropriate for making, processing, packing or holding a drug product, provide equipment that adequately controls air pressure, micro-organisms, dust, humidity and temperature.
items.quote: Equipment for adequate control over air pressure, micro-organisms, dust, humidity, and temperature shall be provided when appropriate for the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product.
items.condition: when appropriate

items.statement: Where appropriate, use air filtration systems, including prefilters and particulate filters, on air supplied to production areas.
items.quote: Air filtration systems, including prefilters and particulate matter air filters, shall be used when appropriate on air supplies to production areas.
items.condition: when appropriate

items.statement: If air is recirculated to production areas, take measures to control recirculation of dust generated by production.
items.quote: If air is recirculated to production areas, measures shall be taken to control recirculation of dust from production.
items.condition: if air is recirculated to production areas

items.statement: In areas where production causes air contamination, provide adequate exhaust or other systems able to control the contaminants.
items.quote: In areas where air contamination occurs during production, there shall be adequate exhaust systems or other systems adequate to control contaminants.
items.condition: where air contamination occurs during production

items.statement: Keep air-handling systems for manufacturing, processing and packing penicillin completely separate from those serving other human drug products.
items.quote: Air-handling systems for the manufacture, processing, and packing of penicillin shall be completely separate from those for other drug products for human use.
items.condition: penicillin operations

not_applicable.text: § 211.46 Ventilation, air filtration, air heating and cooling.

items.statement: Supply potable water under continuous positive pressure through plumbing that has no defects that could contaminate any drug product.
items.quote: Potable water shall be supplied under continuous positive pressure in a plumbing system free of defects that could contribute contamination to any drug product.

items.statement: Ensure potable water meets the EPA Primary Drinking Water Regulations in 40 CFR part 141, and do not allow water that fails those standards into the potable water system.
items.quote: Potable water shall meet the standards prescribed in the Environmental Protection Agency's Primary Drinking Water Regulations set forth in 40 CFR part 141. Water not meeting such standards shall not be permitted in the potable water system.

items.statement: Make drains of adequate size.
items.quote: Drains shall be of adequate size

items.statement: Where a drain connects directly to a sewer, fit it with an air break or other mechanical device that prevents back-siphonage.
items.quote: where connected directly to a sewer, shall be provided with an air break or other mechanical device to prevent back-siphonage.
items.condition: where connected directly to a sewer
